lines.translation: Why are you asleep? Wake up, you ignorant fool!

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tai jeevan jag sach kar jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You believe that your life in the world is true. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਆ ਸੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਅੰਬਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jeeu deeaa s rijak a(n)baraavai ||
lines.translation: The One who gave you life shall also provide you with nourishment.
In each and every heart, He runs His shop.
Meditate on the Lord, and renounce your egotism and self-conceit.
Within your heart, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, sometime. ||2||
Your life has passed away, but you have not arranged your path.
Evening has set in, and soon there will be darkness on all sides.
Says Ravi Daas, O ignorant mad-man,
don't you realize, that this world is the house of death?! ||3||2||
Soohee:
You may have lofty mansions, halls and kitchens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek gharee phun rahan na hoee ||1||
lines.translation: But you cannot stay in them, even for an instant, after death. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan aisaa jaise ghaas kee taatee ||
lines.translation: This body is like a house of straw.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਘਾਸੁ ਰਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal gaio ghaas ral gaio maatee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When it is burnt, it mixes with dust. ||1||Pause||
Even relatives, family and friends begin to say,
"Take his body out, immediately!" ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਰਹਿ ਤਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar kee naar urahi tan laagee ||
lines.translation: And the wife of his house, who was so attached to his body and heart,

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਹ ਤਉ ਭੂਤੁ ਭੂਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: uh tau bhoot bhoot kar bhaagee ||3||
lines.translation: runs away, crying out, "Ghost! Ghost!" ||3||
Says Ravi Daas, the whole world has been plundered,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ham tau ek raam kahi chhootiaa ||4||3||
lines.translation: but I have escaped, chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||4||3||
Raag Soohee, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee baanee sekh phareed jee kee ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਮਰੋਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tap tap luhi luhi haath marorau ||
lines.translation: Burning and burning, writhing in pain, I wring my hands.
I have gone insane, seeking my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tai sahi man mahi keeaa ros ||
lines.translation: O my Husband Lord, You are angry with me in Your Mind.
The fault is with me, and not with my Husband Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tai saahib kee mai saar na jaanee ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, I do not know Your excellence and worth.
Having wasted my youth, now I come to regret and repent. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੀ ਕੋਇਲ ਤੂ ਕਿਤ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaalee koil too kit gun kaalee ||
lines.translation: O black bird, what qualities have made you black?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਬਿਰਹੈ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: apane preetam ke hau birahai jaalee ||
lines.translation: "I have been burnt by separation from my Beloved."
Without her Husband Lord, how can the soul-bride ever find peace?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaa hoi kripaal taa prabhoo milaae ||2||
lines.translation: When He becomes merciful, then God unites us with Himself. ||2||
The lonely soul-bride suffers in the pit of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko saathee naa ko belee ||
lines.translation: She has no companions, and no friends.
In His Mercy, God has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa phir dekhaa taa meraa alahu belee ||3||
lines.translation: And when I look again, then I find God as my Helper. ||3||
The path upon which I must walk is very depressing.
It is sharper than a two-edged sword, and very narrow.
That is where my path lies.
O Shaykh Fareed, think of that path early on. ||4||1||
Soohee, Lalit:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇੜਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਸਕਿਓ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: beRaa ba(n)dh na sakio ba(n)dhan kee velaa ||
lines.translation: You were not able to make yourself a raft when you should have.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਿ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਜਬ ਊਛਲੈ ਤਬ ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhar saravar jab oochhalai tab taran duhelaa ||1||
lines.translation: When the ocean is churning and over-flowing, then it is very difficult to cross over it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਥੁ ਨ ਲਾਇ ਕਸੁੰਭੜੈ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hath na laai kasu(n)bhaRai jal jaasee dholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Do not touch the safflower with your hands; its color will fade away, my dear. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਪਤਲੀ ਸਹ ਕੇਰੇ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik aapeenhai patalee sah kere bolaa ||
lines.translation: First, the bride herself is weak, and then, her Husband Lord's Order is hard to bear.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਧਾ ਥਣੀ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dudhaa thanee na aavaee phir hoi na melaa ||2||
lines.translation: Milk does not return to the breast; it will not be collected again. ||2||
Says Fareed, O my companions, when our Husband Lord calls,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਸੀ ਡੁੰਮਣਾ ਅਹਿ ਤਨੁ ਢੇਰੀ ਥੀਸੀ ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)s chalasee du(n)manaa ahi tan dheree theesee ||3||2||
lines.translation: the soul departs, sad at heart, and this body returns to dust. ||3||2||
